Soup Series Part 1: Marry Me Chicken Noodle Soup 💍❤️

Ingredients:
3 large carrots, chopped
3 celery stalks, chopped
1 yellow onion, chopped
1 small parsnip, chopped
1/4 cup white wine
1 tbsp butter
8 garlic cloves, minced
6 tbsp tomato paste
6 tsp chicken bouillon
6 cups water
1/2 lb noodle of choice, cooked (I like small thick noodle for this recipe so l used tubetti rigati)
1 lb chicken (or 2 chicken breasts). You can also use rotisserie chicken if you want to skip cooking the chicken.
1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking chicken) 
4-5 tbsp chopped sun dried tomatoes (I used ones from a jar)
1 tbsp of oil from the sun dried tomato jar
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1/2 tsp dried parsley
1/2 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp dried basil
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp pepper
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
3/4 cup cream
handful fresh parsley, chopped
handful of fresh basil, chopped
freshly grated parmesan cheese, to top

Method:

Slice chicken breasts in half and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.  In a large pot, cook chicken in avocado oil over medium high heat until cooked all the way through (about 3-4 min each side). Set aside and chop into bite size pieces.

In a separate pot, boil some water and cook your pasta according to package (al dente). Strain and set aside. 

In the same pot you used to cook chicken, heat up sun dried tomato oil over medium heat. Add onions and sauté for a min or so before adding in the white wine to deglaze the pan. Add in celery, carrots, and parsnip. Saute for about 5 min or until they start to soften. 

Create a space in the pan, add the butter and garlic directly into the butter. Cook for another minute, stirring so it does not burn. Add in tomato paste. Stir in and let cook for a few minutes or until the tomato paste starts to turn a slightly darker color before stirring in sun dried tomatoes and chicken bouillon. Add water and seasonings (salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, dried parsley, dried basil, dried oregano, red pepper flakes). Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover, and let cook for about 10 min. Add heavy cream, cooked pasta, cooked chicken, fresh parsley, fresh basil, and parmesan cheese.

#Soup #soupseason #souprecipe
narrated.transcript: Welcome to the first episode of my soup series. It's officially soup season So tonight we're making a merry meat chicken noodle soup I posted this recipe about six months ago, and you guys loved it So I thought it would be the perfect way to kick off the series We are going to start by prepping all of our veggies which includes chopping up some celery carrots Parsnip and onion in a large pot We are going to cook up our chicken breasts I like to slice them in half because I think they cook more evenly once those are done We're going to set aside and cook up our onions and deglaze with a little bit of white wine This will help you scrape off all of the bits from the chicken and really add to the flavor of the soup Then we go in with the rest of our veggies, some garlic, of course, tomato paste, chicken bouillon, and sun-dried tomatoes After mixing those up and letting them cook for a few minutes We're going to add our water and seasonings After letting our soup simmer for about 10 minutes We're going to go ahead and add some heavy cream, our cooked pasta, cooked chicken, fresh herbs, and parmesan cheese This soup is so flavorful, so cozy, and it's easy to make I hope you guys try this one and if you have any requests for soup season, please let me know

caption_only.caption: Him: “Where’s the protein?”  This one-pot pasta recipe is insanely easy and perfect for busy nights. Recipe -2 tbsp oil -2 garlic cloves, minced -2 cups pasta -2 1/2 cups chicken broth -1/4 cup heavy cream -3 tbsp butter -1/2 cup parmesan cheese -Salt & pepper, to taste -Parsley, for garnish 1.Heat a large skillet over medium and add the oil. 2.Sauté the garlic until fragrant. 3.Toss in the dry pasta, stirring to coat in the oil. 4.Pour in the chicken broth and simmer until the pasta absorbs all the liquid. 5.Stir in heavy cream, butter, and parmesan cheese until creamy. 6.Season with salt and pepper to taste. 7.Finish with a sprinkle of parsley and an extra pat of butter. #creamypasta #pastarecipe
